title: English - Creative Writing Option
sourceText:
Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Humanities [HUM]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Elective

Arts [ARTS]

ENGLISH 251

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

ENGLISH 351 or 353

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

Social Sciences [SSCI]

Electives

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

Diversity [DIVR]

ENGLISH 352

300-400-level Literature Elective
Literature Electives: Approved courses include ENGLISH 305, 306, 309, 311, 315, 317, 322, 332, 341, 366, 370, 371, 372, 373, 382, 409, 419, 470, and 480-489.

Complete University Writing Portfolio

ENGLISH 302 [M]

ENGLISH 343, 354, 357, 402 [M], 498, OR 499

ENGLISH 451 [M], 452 [M], or 453

Writers of Color Course
Writers of Color Courses: Choose from ENGLISH 220, 222, 310, 311, 315 [M], 316, 322 [M], 341 [M], 345 [M], 489, or CES 331.

300-400-level Electives

300-400-level Creative Writing or Literature Elective
Approved courses include any 300-400-level ENGLISH courses not used to fulfill other requirements.

400-level Literature Elective
Literature Electives: Approved courses include ENGLISH 305, 306, 309, 311, 315, 317, 322, 332, 341, 366, 370, 371, 372, 373, 382, 409, 419, 470, and 480-489.

Complete Senior Exit Survey

ENGLISH 446 [CAPS]

A student may be admitted to the English – Creative Writing Option upon making their intention known to the department.

Requirements in this option involve a minimum of 39 credits, approximately half in creative writing and related professional courses, the remainder in supporting literature courses approved by the advisor.
